hadith:
Prophets - Narrated Abu Huraira:

Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "It was said to Bani Israel, Enter the gate (of the town) with humility (prostrating yourselves) and saying: "Repentance", but they changed the word and entered the town crawling on their buttocks and saying: "A wheat grain in the hair."
message: Allah, the Most Beneficent, has given us the Quran and the ability to speak so that we may communicate truth and seek His forgiveness through sincere repentance. When we approach Allah with genuine humility and honest hearts—rather than empty words or pretense—we align ourselves with His name Al Ghaffaar, the Constant Forgiver, who continuously invites us to turn back to Him with mercy and compassion.
name:
Al Ghaffaar - الْغَفَّارُ - The Forgiving

The meaning of Al Ghaffaar is 'The Constant Forgiver' or 'The Forgiving One'. It emphasizes Allah's willingness to forgive sins repeatedly and His mercy towards humanity. This name signifies that Allah continually provides opportunities for repentance and seeks to cover and forgive shortcomings, highlighting His compassion and understanding.
verse:
Ar-Rahman - The Beneficent - 55:1-4

The Most Beneficent taught the Quran, created humanity, ˹and˺ taught them speech.
